metadata.purpose: Run planner and parent transfer, then call build_smoothing_plan(plan) exactly as production run_skirt_parent_workflow does.
metadata.evidence: Managed Maya 2024 reused the existing session on port 7001 after ff-only sync from 42d1db48853b815a9b81941fb78092a9df8929f1 to 6ae4b8eb628c1db14d92fbb674255a07bcb32a15, forced a fresh unsaved scene, and timed out after 120 seconds with scene_saved=false and maya_quit=false. This diagnostic matches the production smoothing-plan call after a proven parent-transfer phase, so the current blocker is inside or below post-transfer smoothing-plan topology grouping. Timeout alone does not prove Maya crashed.

metadata.purpose: After the proven planner+transfer phase, run only the first smoothing span through group_vertices_by_perpendicular_loops using its default bounded API topology path, isolating whether a single post-transfer loop-group call is the production blocker.
acceptance: Fast-forward main and include diagnostic smoke commit 72f0dba18f804ac714bb447108fb17bfb97e870c or later.

Start from a healthy managed Maya 2024 session. If the previous timeout left the listener/process unresponsive, terminate the stale managed Maya process before attempting this diagnostic; do not reuse a confirmed hung session.
Force a fresh unsaved scene and do not save or quit Maya.

Run skirt_parent_post_transfer_loop_group_smoke and require AIBRIDGE_UI_SMOKE_OK:SKINNING_SKIRT_PARENT_POST_TRANSFER_LOOP_GROUP_SMOKE_OK. If this times out on a healthy session, classify the first default API loop-group call after transfer as the blocker; if it passes, continue with bounded span-by-span isolation.
